gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Dreamy, drifting, wide-spaced letters. Noto Sans Hanunoo grounds them with tall lowercase and open terminals, which is the real strength here: Starborn floats and the body stays put.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Starborn spreads its dark, heavy lowercase across wide gaps, giving each line a dreamy, starlit drift. And Noto Sans Hebrew fills the line with a deep midsection and open curves, so the text underneath feels steady and modern.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-hk: Noto Sans HK reads large and crisp, its lowercase nearly touching the ascenders and its brush ends lifting away from each curve. And Starborn does the dreaming, with loose spacing and a dark stripe of lowercase, while the sans handles the plain talking.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-imperia: Starborn lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase across wide, ethereal gaps. And Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic follows with open pincer-like c shapes and a small step up to the capitals, so a modest size is enough for it.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-inscrip: Starborn is dreamy and spaced out, its dark lowercase running through each line like a band of night sky. But Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian, with big open eyes and a deep middle band, would make a long stretch feel easy and unhurried.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-jp: Noto Sans JP reads tall and modern, its curves sweeping open. Starborn adds a dreamy, widely spaced heading above it, so the page moves between a soft, starry drift and a crisp, plain sans.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Dreamy, spacious and a little otherworldly. Starborn's dark lowercase stripe sits over Noto Sans Kaithi, whose open e and capital-sized lowercase fill each line with a steady, contemporary hum.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada has a gentle rise from small letters to capitals and s curves that open wide at both ends. And over many lines it stays approachable and smooth, a quiet contrast to Starborn's thick, widely spaced dreaminess.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-kayah-l: Starborn stretches wide, ethereal gaps between thick, dark lowercase letters. Noto Sans Kayah Li sits beside it with lifted brush ends and capitals barely taller than the lowercase, giving a clean, sans-serif counterweight to all that drift.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-kharosh: Dreamy, dark-striped and wide open to the sky. But Noto Sans Kharoshthi has the pair's strongest quality: its curves never close back on themselves, which keeps the plain sans approachable under Starborn's heavy float.
